name: Baidu
note: All prefixes announced by Baidu ASNs. Does not cover Baidu services hosted in China Telecom/Unicom IDC space — see paddle.

name: Coder
note: Resolves coder.com, registry.coder.com and related hosts. Most sit behind Cloudflare/Vercel — ranges are shared, not Coder-owned.

name: Exa AI
note: Resolves exa.ai API/app/docs hosts plus the legacy metaphor.systems. Most sit behind Cloudflare/Vercel — ranges are shared CDN edge, not Exa-owned.

name: Google Gemini / Vertex AI
note: Attribution split of google/, not extra coverage — every address here is already in google/, as /32s that win on longest-prefix. Web hosts separate cleanly; the API does not: generativelanguage and all *-aiplatform endpoints share www.googleapis.com's frontend addresses.

name: Google (GoogleBot)
note: To allow GoogleBot, block all Google IPs first, then allow these.

name: Grok (xAI)
note: Resolves grok.com and x.ai hosts, including the regional API endpoints (us-east-1, us-west-1, eu-west-1, asia-south1). Most sit behind Cloudflare/GCP — ranges are shared edge, not xAI-owned.

name: Hetzner
note: All prefixes announced by Hetzner ASNs (AS24940 Online, AS213230 Cloud).

name: iMobie (FocuSee)
note: FocuSee account/license/AI-voice hosts across imobie.com and imobie-resource.com. Several are Cloudflare/CloudFront/Incapsula-fronted — shared CDN edge IPs.

name: OpenRouter
note: Site, status and Clerk-backed auth hosts; the API is served from openrouter.ai/api/v1, not a separate host. All Cloudflare-fronted — shared CDN edge IPs, and the auth hosts are shared Clerk infrastructure.

name: PaddlePaddle
note: Model/wheel download hosts and AI Studio. Resolved via several resolvers — Baidu GeoDNS answers differ per region.
